title: 有馬記念の後に・“帝王”君臨

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a roar from the crowd, Tokai Teio wins the Arima Kinen. However, it takes a while for reality to set in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf praises her and proclaims that she will one day take back the throne that was stolen from her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her words finally make Tokai Teio realize that she's surpassed the Emperor at last.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At Symboli Rudolf's prodding, Tokai Teio heads off to stand in front of the crowd and proclaim the birth of a new Monarch.
